name: Honcho
description: Honcho is an open-source memory library for building stateful AI agents. It provides long-term memory, theory-of-mind user modeling, and a dialectic API so agents can reason about users across sessions. Runs on FastAPI with PostgreSQL + pgvector.

notes.text: An LLM provider API key (Google Gemini, Anthropic, or OpenAI) is required for memory derivation. Add it to /opt/honcho/.env and run: systemctl restart honcho honcho-deriver
Two services are installed: honcho (API server, port 8000) and honcho-deriver (background worker that processes memory).
PostgreSQL credentials are saved to ~/honcho.creds inside the container. API authentication is disabled by default (AUTH_USE_AUTH=false) - enable it before exposing the service.
